# {module} — Module Rulebook

> Generated by the BMAD Onboard agent from a discovery scan of `{module_path}`.
> Read the root rulebook first. This file adds module-specific detail; where the two disagree, raise it as a
> compliance note in section 17. Do not edit by hand without the rulebook Write Guard.

Every heading below is required and must keep its number and text, because BMAD benchmarks find sections by
heading. When a section does not apply, write `N/A — {reason}` under it. Every fact must trace to a file in
`{module_path}`, a migration, or a rule in the root rulebook. Cite `path:line` where it helps.

UI modules fill the "UI" variant of sections 3, 4, 6 and 7. Service modules fill the "Service" variant.

## 8. Money, Numbers and Precision

| Field / value | Type used | Scale / precision | Rounding mode and step | Currency carried | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

List every monetary amount, price, rate, fee and fractional quantity the module handles. Flag binary floating
point, implicit rounding, scale-sensitive equality and bare amounts without currency (BFSI-MON-01…07).

---

## 9. Lifecycle Entities and State Machines

| Entity | States (terminal marked ★) | Transitions evidenced in code | Enforced in | Event published |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Flag transitions not validated in one place, terminal states that can change, and in-place corrections
(BFSI-STATE-01, -02, BFSI-TRADE-05).

---

## 10. Regulated Data and Classification

| Field | Entity / DTO | Classification (public / internal / confidential / restricted) | Masked in logs and responses | Encrypted at rest |
|---|---|---|---|---|

List every field holding personal or financial identifiers (card number, account number, IBAN, government id,
date of birth, contact details, credentials). Flag any found in log statements (BFSI-SEC-02, -03).

|---|---|---|
